title: Trump Calls CNN's Don Lemon 'The Dumbest Man on Television'
description_short: Trump Calls CNN's Don Lemon 'The Dumbest Man on Television'
description_medium: On August 3, 2018, Trump attacked CNN anchor Don Lemon on Twitter, calling him 'the dumbest man on television' in a tweet that also targeted LeBron James after Lemon aired an interview with the athlete. Trump had previously called Lemon 'a real dummy,' 'not very bright,' and made multiple other public attacks on Lemon's intelligence over the years. Commentators noted that Trump's pattern of publicly attacking Black public figures' intelligence — Maxine Waters, LeBron James, Don Lemon, Al Sharpton, Barack Obama — followed a consistent racial targeting pattern.
description_long:
On August 3, 2018, Trump attacked CNN anchor Don Lemon on Twitter, calling him 'the dumbest man on television' in a tweet that also targeted LeBron James after Lemon aired an interview with the athlete. Trump had previously called Lemon 'a real dummy,' 'not very bright,' and made multiple other public attacks on Lemon's intelligence over the years. Commentators noted that Trump's pattern of publicly attacking Black public figures' intelligence — Maxine Waters, LeBron James, Don Lemon, Al Sharpton, Barack Obama — followed a consistent racial targeting pattern. Lemon continued his journalism career and later wrote about the psychological impact of sustained attacks from a sitting president.

The tweet followed a broadcast interview, placing the attack within Trump's conflict with a prominent news presenter and an athlete who had spoken publicly. The quoted insult is not evidence about Lemon's intelligence or the merits of his reporting. Commentators' assessment of a broader racial pattern should remain attributed to them. The entry records personal denigration by the president and the reactions it prompted, without assuming a measurable effect on the interview audience or every subsequent professional decision.
